Interface HomeSecurityAssignment.HomeSecurityADT

All Known Implementing Classes:
HomeSecurityAssignment.HomeSecurityImpl
Enclosing class:
HomeSecurityAssignment
public static interface HomeSecurityAssignment.HomeSecurityADT
The interface representing the abstract data type (ADT) of a home security system.

Invariants:
1. password != null && password.length() > 0.
2. state ∈ {DISARMED, ARMED, STAY}.
3. if state == ARMED: all sensors must be non-violated.
4. if state == STAY: all external sensors must be non-violated.

Equational Axioms:
1. Arm() possible ⇔ all sensors not violated.
2. Stay() possible ⇔ external sensors not violated ^ state == DISARMED.
3. Disarm(pwd) possible ⇔ pwd == current password.
4. ChangePassword(old, new) possible ⇔ state == DISARMED ^ old == current password.

    • Arm

      void Arm() throws HomeSecurityAssignment.InternalSensorViolationException, HomeSecurityAssignment.ExternalSensorViolationException
      [ Transformer | Setter ]
      Arms the alarm system fully.
      Throws:
      HomeSecurityAssignment.InternalSensorViolationException - if any internal sensor line is violated.
      HomeSecurityAssignment.ExternalSensorViolationException - if any external sensor line is violated.
      Precondition:
      all internal and external sensor lines must not be violated.
      Postcondition:
      system state becomes ARMED.

    • Stay

      void Stay() throws HomeSecurityAssignment.ExternalSensorViolationException, HomeSecurityAssignment.NotDisarmedException
      [ Transformer | Setter ]
      Activates "STAY" mode (external sensors active, internal inactive).
      Throws:
      HomeSecurityAssignment.ExternalSensorViolationException - if an external sensor line is violated.
      HomeSecurityAssignment.NotDisarmedException - if system is not in DISARMED state.
      Precondition:
      system must be DISARMED && all external sensor lines must not be violated.
      Postcondition:
      system state becomes STAY.

    • Disarm

      void Disarm(String password) throws HomeSecurityAssignment.WrongPasswordException
      [ Transformer | Setter ]
      Disarms the system from ARMED or STAY state.
      Parameters:
      password - the password needed to disarm the system.
      Throws:
      HomeSecurityAssignment.WrongPasswordException - if provided password does not match the current one.
      Precondition:
      current state is ARMED or STAY.
      Postcondition:
      system state becomes DISARMED.

    • ChangePassword

      void ChangePassword(String oldpassword, String newpassword) throws HomeSecurityAssignment.WrongPasswordException, HomeSecurityAssignment.NotDisarmedException
      [ Transformer | Setter ]
      Changes the system password.
      Parameters:
      oldpassword - the current password.
      newpassword - the new password to set.
      Throws:
      HomeSecurityAssignment.WrongPasswordException - if oldpassword is incorrect.
      HomeSecurityAssignment.NotDisarmedException - if system is not DISARMED.
      Precondition:
      system is DISARMED, oldpassword.equals(getPassword()).
      Postcondition:
      password becomes newpassword.
